presentation.label: RING
presentation.summary: A spinning ring that follows your signal, full screen. Passes the sound through.
presentation.overview: A spinning ring that follows your signal, full screen. Passes the sound through.
highlights: Watch the rotating trace respond to quiet and loud input while the audio passes through.
usage: Add Ring from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Watch the rotating trace respond to quiet and loud input while the audio passes through.
Compare the effect with bypass using the footswitch.

access.location: Delay group in the MS-70CDR effect list, under Ring.
steps: Add Ring from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Watch the rotating trace respond to quiet and loud input while the audio passes through.

controls.name: Time
controls.doc: How much signal goes around the ring: 1-64 samples per point. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Size
controls.doc: How far the signal pushes the ring in and out. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Spin
controls.doc: 50 = still; below spins one way, above the other. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.

load.conditions: The effect descriptor declares this cost. Audio load on the pedal is unmeasured.

tests.summary: Ziddle passed the loader check and rendered 22,050 stereo frames. The compiled file passed the stock-code scan and MS-70CDR size limits. Hardware untested.
